name: highlighter
description: After each reply, Claude Haiku picks what to highlight: yellow for what needs your decision, blue for the key result, red for warnings, green for verified results. The main model is never told. /highlight-preview shows what each color means.

model.title: Highlight model
model.description: The model that picks the highlights: a model id such as claude-haiku-5-5, or haiku for the model Claude Code currently calls Haiku.
